title: Headcount & Interview Loop - 1:1 Prep and Follow-ups
content:
Meeting: Weekly headcount sync / 1:1 prep with Maya
Date: 2026-03-02 (sync scheduled)
Owner: Jordan Lee
Context:
- Quick personal prep notes ahead of 1:1 with Maya (eng manager, hiring lead). Focus: review open reqs, interview loop health, debrief actions, and proposals for next-quarter headcount requests.
- High-level constraint: hiring budget for Eng is approved but hiring velocity needs justification for Q3 ramp. Finance flagged two roles for additional sign-off.

Objectives for 1:1:
1) Align on open reqs priority (which to accelerate vs pause).
2) Identify interview loop bottlenecks and concrete actions to shorten time-to-offer.
3) Confirm debrief cadence and who owns candidate follow-ups.
4) Draft ask for org planning meeting (headcount delta + rationale).

Current open reqs (summary):
- Senior Software Engineer (Serving Runtime) - req #SR-47 - 4 candidates in loop (onsite planned). Interviewers: Ravi, Priya, Sam. Concern: scheduling gaps, 2-week delay in technical round.
- ML Infra Engineer - req #MI-11 - offer extended to Cand A (pending comp approval).
- SWE (Platform) - req #PL-22 - on hold (need product prioritization).
- Staff SRE - req #SRE-05 - frozen until Q3 confirmed.

Interview loop health & issues:
- Too many blockers at take-home stage: candidates waiting for reviewer feedback (avg 6 days).
- Debrief not consistently attended by hiring manager; delays in consensus.
- Interviewer bandwidth: Ravi and Priya are overloaded; consider adding backup interviewers from adjacent teams.
- Score variance: we lack a calibrated rubric for senior roles -> inconsistent debrief outcomes.

Proposed immediate actions (talking points & follow-ups):
- Action 1: Create a short SLA for take-home review (48-72 hours). Owner: Maya to coordinate with interviewers. Due: 2026-03-09.
- Action 2: Add two backup interviewers for Serving Runtime loops (Sam -> backup: Lee H., and add EngInfra reviewer). Owner: Jordan. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Action 3: Run a 30-min calibration session for senior IC rubric (focus: system design, perf tradeoffs, runtime optimization). Owner: Ravi. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Action 4: Draft a short candidate follow-up template to reduce time between decision and offer. Owner: People Ops (cc: Maya). Linked artifact: GitHub PR with template. Due: 2026-03-04.
- Action 5: For req SR-47, propose compressing interview window to 7 days (currently 14+). Need agreement from interviewers. Owner: Jordan/Maya. Due: 2026-03-08.

Debrief template (quick reference for the meeting):
- Candidate name / role / resume highlights
- Interviewer scores (1-5) across rubric dimensions: technical depth, systems thinking, performance optimization, collaboration, communications
- Specific concerns (if any) + examples
- Hire / No-hire / Maybe + next steps (e.g., offer, second loop, decline)
- Ownership for comms & timeline

Notes to bring up in 1:1 (questions & prompts):
- "Which roles are mission-critical for Q3 ramp? If we deprioritize SR-47, what is the downstream impact?"
- "Can we formalize a 48-72h review SLA? What blockers might prevent adoption?"
- "Do we have capacity to run a 30-min rubric calibration early next week? Who should be mandatory vs optional?"
- "Is comp approval for Cand A (MI-11) expected this week? Any blockers I should escalate to finance?"

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: Losing high-quality candidates due to slow loop. Mitigation: SLA + backup interviewers + faster offer templates.
- Risk: Hiring freeze on certain bands (SRE-05). Mitigation: prepare justification with business impact metrics for org planning meeting.

Org planning ask (to bring to product/eng headcount sync):
- Request: +2 Senior SWE (Serving Runtime) for Q3 to support performance and batching features. Justification bullets: 1) latency/cost features planned require 1.5 FTEs of infra work for 6 months; 2) current team overloaded, increased time-to-ship risk.
- Fallback: prioritize 1 hire + contract support for kernel optimization (3 months).

Follow-ups (after 1:1) - to log in tracker and assign:
- [ ] Maya to update req priorities in Greenhouse and tag reqs with "urgent" for hiring ops. (Maya) Due 2026-03-04
- [ ] Jordan to short-list backup interviewers and ping EngInfra for cross-team reviewer. (Jordan) Due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Ravi to schedule rubric calibration meeting and circulate pre-reads. (Ravi) Due 2026-03-10
- [ ] People Ops to prepare candidate comms template and offer checklist. (People Ops) Due 2026-03-04
- [ ] Finance check-in for comp approval (HR) - escalate if not approved by 2026-03-06. (Maya/HR Partner)

Quick debrief notes (template to fill post-1:1):
- Decisions made: 
- Changes to req priority: 
- New owners assigned: 
- Next sync date: 

Misc notes / scratch:
- Candidate pipeline looks healthy for MI-11 but fragile for SR-47 (need to accelerate).
- Consider running a "fast track" loop for top-tier candidates (2 rounds + hiring manager) with recruiter pre-screen checklist.
- Link to current loop docs: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/Interview+Loops (bring up calibration examples)

"Notes to self": keep this doc concise and move action items into the team hiring tracker after the 1:1. Mark completed items with dates.

End of prep notes.
